provenance.method: gemini-3-pro-image through scripts/art/gemini-image.py, with the canonical athlete attached to every generation. Frames 1-4 as in version 1 (a master and edits from the pose before; frame 2 drawn between 1 and 3). Frame 5: a half-kneel drawn in profile from frame 4, flipped left to right. Frame 6: an edit of frame 5 up to standing, in the same profile. Frames 1-4 came back 3:2 and were padded square with black above. Every frame was then scaled (frames 1-4 by 0.87 x 0.95, frame 5 by 0.83 x 0.95, frame 6 by 0.95), set centred on one floor line, and near-black pixels clamped to pure black. Nothing was redrawn by hand.

findings: Frames 5 and 6 are in profile at about eye level, where frames 1-4 look down from a little above; the athlete no longer turns to face the viewer, which version 1 recorded.
Frame 5 is a generated half-kneel flipped left to right, so the bell stays in the left hand as in frames 1-4.
Every frame was scaled by one uniform resample to frame 6's size and set on one floor line; the lying figures are small in the square.
No contacts or anchors were measured.
